title: Prognosis Value of Pro-adrenomedullin in Acute Exacerbations of COPD in ER
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether pro-adrenomedullin (Mr proADM)in addition to clinical evaluation is effective to predict outcome of acute exacerbations of COPD patients visiting the emergency room(ER).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients \> 40 years old
* Acute exacerbation of COPD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medico social conditions not allowing home discharge
* Other causes of Dyspnea: Pneumothorax, pulmonary embolism, pulmonary oedema, lung cancer
* Pneumonia on chest ray
* acute respiratory distress requiring immediate ICU transfer
condition: Pulmonary Disease, Chronic Obstructive Patients Admitted in Emergency Department for Acute Exacerbation
